ov: The European robin is a small insect-eating songbird with an orange-red breast and face, found across Europe to Western Siberia and North Africa. It’s unrelated to the larger American robin, a thrush. Unafraid of people, it follows gardeners for the worms they dig up.
rg: Europe, east to Western Siberia and south to North Africa.
df: Mainly insects, plus seed mixtures and scraps from bird tables; occasionally small vertebrates.
fx: Because so many die in their first year, a robin’s average life expectancy is just 1.1 years.
Males fight fiercely over territory; in some areas fights cause up to 10% of adult robin deaths.
notes: The existing fact (fights to the death) is confirmed: territorial fights cause up to 10% of adult deaths in some areas.
